title: 5. Complex Sentence ও Subordinate Clause
group: মডিউল ২ · Band 7.0+ Complex Structures ও Range Booster
blocks: Band 7-এর জন্য সবচেয়ে গুরুত্বপূর্ণ একক structure। Clause-এর মূল ধারণা, sentence-এর ৩টি ধরন, adverbial ও relative clause, comma-র নিয়ম, আর fragment, run-on ও comma splice ঠিক করা।

মডিউল ১ আপনার sentence-গুলোকে নির্ভুল করেছে। মডিউল ২ সেগুলোতে বৈচিত্র্য আনবে। এই ধাপে এসে লেখা আর ছোট ছোট নিরাপদ বাক্যের তালিকার মতো শোনায় না, বরং একটা যুক্ত argument-এর মতো পড়া যায়। Grammatical Range and Accuracy-র Band 7 descriptor চায় “a variety of complex structures used with some flexibility”, আর এই মডিউল ঠিক সেটাই দেয়: subordinate clause দিয়ে তৈরি complex sentence, academic tone-এর জন্য passive voice, আর সম্ভাবনা নিয়ে যুক্তি দেওয়ার জন্য conditional।

Band 7-এ পৌঁছানোর জন্য complex sentence-ই সবচেয়ে গুরুত্বপূর্ণ একক structure, কারণ range-এর সবচেয়ে স্পষ্ট প্রমাণ এটাই। এর মাধ্যমে আপনি দুটো বিচ্ছিন্ন ছোট sentence-এর বদলে একটা নিয়ন্ত্রিত sentence-এর ভেতরেই দুটো ধারণার যৌক্তিক সম্পর্ক (contrast, reason, condition, time) দেখাতে পারেন।
5.1 Clause-এর মূল ধারণা (এখান থেকে শুরু করুন)
Clause হলো এমন একগুচ্ছ শব্দ যার একটা subject আর একটা verb আছে। Clause ২ রকমের, আর পুরো অধ্যায়টা দাঁড়িয়ে আছে এই দুটোকে আলাদা করে চিনতে পারার উপর।
Independent clause একটা সম্পূর্ণ ভাব প্রকাশ করে এবং একা একটা sentence হিসেবে দাঁড়াতে পারে: “Cities offer jobs.”

Dependent (subordinate) clause-এ subject আর verb থাকে, কিন্তু একা দাঁড়াতে পারে না, কারণ এর শুরুতে থাকা subordinating শব্দটা একে অসম্পূর্ণ রেখে দেয়: “Although cities offer jobs …” — এটা শুনে আপনি বাকিটার জন্য অপেক্ষা করেন।
Complex sentence একটা independent clause-এর সাথে অন্তত একটা dependent clause জোড়ে: Although cities offer jobs, (dependent) they are crowded. (independent)
5.2 Sentence-এর ৩টি ধরন, আর কেন complex sentence নম্বর এনে দেয়
Cities offer jobs, but they are crowded.
Although cities offer jobs, they are crowded.

Band 5-এর লেখায় বেশিরভাগই simple sentence থাকে। Band 6-এর লেখায় simple আর compound মেশানো থাকে। Band 7-এর লেখা complex sentence নিয়ন্ত্রণ করে এবং নানা রকম complex sentence ব্যবহার করে। এর মূল হাতিয়ার ২টি: adverbial clause (5.3) আর relative clause (5.4)।

Adverbial clause হলো এমন একটা dependent clause যা একটা subordinating conjunction দিয়ে শুরু হয় এবং দেখায় তার ধারণাটা main clause-এর সাথে কীভাবে সম্পর্কিত। Subordinator-গুলো কোন সম্পর্ক বোঝায়, সেই অনুযায়ী দল বেঁধে শিখুন।
Although it is costly, it works.
Prices rose because demand outstripped supply.
if, unless, provided that, as long as
Unless action is taken, the trend will continue.
Laws were tightened so that accidents would fall.
The cost was so high that the plan collapsed.
উদ্দেশ্য বোঝাতে সবচেয়ে কাজের সংক্ষিপ্ত রূপ হলো in order to + base verb (অথবা শুধু to + base verb): The city expanded the metro in order to reduce congestion.

Dependent clause আগে এলে তার পরে comma দিন। পরে এলে সাধারণত comma লাগে না। Although it is costly, it works. (dependent clause সামনে, তাই comma) / It works although it is costly. (dependent clause পরে, comma নেই)

Relative clause একটা relative pronoun (who, which, that, where, whose) ব্যবহার করে কোনো noun সম্পর্কে তথ্য যোগ করে। এর ফলে যা দুটো ছোট sentence হতো, তা একটা পরিণত sentence-এ গুটিয়ে আনা যায় — যা সরাসরি range বাড়ায়।
Students who study abroad gain independence.
Solar power, which is clean, is expanding.
The policy that failed was expensive.
Cities where rents are high lose young workers.
Families whose income is low need support.
Defining বনাম non-defining: comma অর্থ বদলে দেয়
নম্বর আসে এই অংশ থেকেই, আর এটা কোনো সাজসজ্জা নয়। Comma-গুলো sentence-এর অর্থই বদলে দেয়।
Defining clause বলে দেয় ঠিক কোনটা, তাই এটা অপরিহার্য। এতে কোনো comma বসে না। Students who cheat are expelled. (শুধু যারা cheat করে তারা)
Non-defining clause বাড়তি, অপ্রয়োজনীয় তথ্য যোগ করে, আর এর দুই পাশে comma দিয়ে ঘেরা থাকে। The students, who were tired, left early. (সবাই)
that শুধু defining clause-এ ব্যবহার করুন। Non-defining clause-এ which বা who ব্যবহার করুন, কখনোই that নয়। ভুল: My school, that is very old, is famous. সঠিক: My school, which is very old, is famous.

Relative clause-এর পরে pronoun দিয়ে subject আবার বসাবেন না। বাংলাদেশিদের মধ্যে এটা খুবই সাধারণ একটা ভুল। ভুল: People which live in cities they pay more rent. সঠিক: People who live in cities pay more rent.

Reduced relative clause (Band 8-এর ছোঁয়া): প্রায়ই relative pronoun আর be verb বাদ দিয়ে phrase-টাকে আরও আঁটসাঁট করা যায়। Governments that invest in renewables … → Governments investing in renewables … / The report which was published last year … → The report published last year …

শিক্ষার্থীরা যখন প্রথম complex sentence লিখতে যান, তখন ৩টি punctuation-এর ভুল দেখা দেয়। তিনটিই আসে একটা clause কোথায় শেষ আর পরেরটা কোথায় শুরু — সেটা এখনও অনুভব করতে না পারা থেকে। দুটো independent clause জোড়ার বৈধ উপায় ৪টি: full stop, semicolon, comma + একটা coordinating conjunction (FANBOYS), অথবা subordinator দিয়ে একটা clause-কে dependent clause বানিয়ে ফেলা। শুধু একটা comma কখনোই এর মধ্যে পড়ে না।

ভুল ১ · Fragment (একটা dependent clause-কে একা ছেড়ে দেওয়া)।
✗ Because the weather was bad. The event was cancelled.
✓ Because the weather was bad, the event was cancelled.

ভুল ২ · Run-on (দুটো clause কোনো সংযোগ ছাড়াই)।
✗ I studied hard I failed the exam.
✓ I studied hard, but I failed the exam.

ভুল ৩ · Comma splice (দুটো clause শুধু একটা comma দিয়ে জোড়া)।
✗ Internet use rose rapidly, people spent more time online.
✓ Internet use rose rapidly, so people spent more time online.

অফিসিয়াল Band 7 descriptor-এর phrase-টা হলো “a variety of complex structures”। এখানে variety শব্দটাই আসল: যে essay-তে শুধু because clause আছে, প্রতিটি সঠিক হলেও সেটা range দেখায় না। একটা Task 2 essay জুড়ে ছড়িয়ে ব্যবহার করার লক্ষ্য রাখুন: একটা contrast clause (although), একটা reason clause (since), একটা conditional (if), আর এক-দুটো relative clause।

যে skill-এ কাজে লাগে: Writing, Speaking
Task 2 (contrast + relative): While online learning widens access, it cannot fully replace the discipline that a classroom provides.
Task 2 (reason + condition): Because demand continues to rise, prices will keep climbing unless supply increases.
Speaking Part 3: People who grow up in cities often value convenience, whereas those from rural areas tend to prioritise community.
অধ্যায় ৫ শেষ। এরপর অধ্যায় ৬ (Passive Voice & Academic Detachment)।

title: 5. Practice · Complex Sentence ও Subordinate Clause
group: মডিউল ২ · Band 7.0+ Complex Structures ও Range Booster
blocks: Simple sentence আপনাকে Band 5 পর্যন্ত নিয়ে যায়। Complex sentence -- একটা independent clause + একটা dependent clause -- এটাই Band 7-এর লেখা নিয়ন্ত্রণ করে এবং বৈচিত্র্য আনে। মূল ২টি হাতিয়ার শিখুন: adverbial clause আর relative clause।
**কেন গুরুত্বপূর্ণ:** Sentence-এর বৈচিত্র্য সরাসরি নম্বর পায়, আর Band 5-6-এর লেখা থেকে Band 7+-এ ওঠার সবচেয়ে বড় একক হাতিয়ার হলো complex sentence।
Cities offer jobs, but they are crowded.
Although cities offer jobs, they are crowded.

Band 5-এর লেখায় বেশিরভাগই simple sentence থাকে। Band 6-এর লেখায় simple আর compound মেশানো থাকে। **Band 7-এর লেখা complex sentence নিয়ন্ত্রণ করে এবং সেগুলোতে বৈচিত্র্য আনে** -- adverbial clause (if/although/because) আর relative clause (who/which/that) দুটোই ব্যবহার করে।

blocks.title: Exercise 5.1 · Sentence জোড়া লাগানো
blocks.instructions: প্রতিটি জোড়া simple sentence-কে একটা complex sentence-এ পরিণত করুন — bracket-এ দেওয়া সম্পর্কটা মেনে, relative clause অথবা adverbial clause ব্যবহার করে।

items.prompt: Public transport is cheap. Many people still drive. (contrast)
items.answer: Although public transport is cheap, many people still drive.
accepted: Although public transport is cheap, many people still drive.

items.prompt: The lake dried up. Rainfall had declined for years. (reason)
items.answer: The lake dried up because rainfall had declined for years.
accepted: The lake dried up because rainfall had declined for years.

items.prompt: The company hired a manager. She had ten years of experience. (relative)
items.answer: The company hired a manager who had ten years of experience.
accepted: The company hired a manager who had ten years of experience.

items.prompt: Governments invest in education. Their economies tend to grow faster. (relative / condition)
items.answer: Governments that invest in education tend to see their economies grow faster.
accepted: Governments that invest in education tend to see their economies grow faster.

items.prompt: Fees rose sharply. Enrolment dropped. (time)
items.answer: Once fees rose sharply, enrolment dropped.
accepted: Once fees rose sharply, enrolment dropped.
When fees rose sharply, enrolment dropped.

items.prompt: The city built new cycle lanes. It wanted to cut congestion. (purpose)
items.answer: The city built new cycle lanes in order to cut congestion.
accepted: The city built new cycle lanes in order to cut congestion.

items.prompt: Renewable energy is expensive at first. It becomes cheaper over time. (contrast)
items.answer: Although renewable energy is expensive at first, it becomes cheaper over time.
accepted: Although renewable energy is expensive at first, it becomes cheaper over time.

items.prompt: The report was published last year. It highlighted the housing crisis. (relative, non-defining)
items.answer: The report, which was published last year, highlighted the housing crisis.
accepted: The report, which was published last year, highlighted the housing crisis.

items.prompt: Action is not taken soon. The situation will worsen. (condition)
items.answer: Unless action is taken soon, the situation will worsen.
accepted: Unless action is taken soon, the situation will worsen.

items.prompt: Many families live in rural areas. They lack access to good hospitals. (relative)
items.answer: Many families who live in rural areas lack access to good hospitals.
accepted: Many families who live in rural areas lack access to good hospitals.

items.prompt: The policy was popular. It was eventually withdrawn. (contrast)
items.answer: Although the policy was popular, it was eventually withdrawn.
accepted: Although the policy was popular, it was eventually withdrawn.

items.prompt: Solar power is clean. It is expanding rapidly. (relative, non-defining)
items.answer: Solar power, which is clean, is expanding rapidly.
accepted: Solar power, which is clean, is expanding rapidly.

items.prompt: Demand outstripped supply. Prices rose sharply. (reason)
items.answer: Prices rose sharply because demand outstripped supply.
accepted: Prices rose sharply because demand outstripped supply.

items.prompt: Students study abroad. They gain independence and confidence. (relative)
items.answer: Students who study abroad gain independence and confidence.
accepted: Students who study abroad gain independence and confidence.

items.prompt: The factory closed in 1998. Hundreds of workers lost their jobs. (time / result)
items.answer: When the factory closed in 1998, hundreds of workers lost their jobs.
accepted: When the factory closed in 1998, hundreds of workers lost their jobs.

items.prompt: Cities are crowded and expensive. Young workers often leave them. (reason)
items.answer: Because cities are crowded and expensive, young workers often leave them.
accepted: Because cities are crowded and expensive, young workers often leave them.

items.prompt: The government raises taxes. Public services can be funded properly. (purpose)
items.answer: The government raises taxes so that public services can be funded properly.
accepted: The government raises taxes so that public services can be funded properly.

items.prompt: This is the town. I grew up there. (relative, place)
items.answer: This is the town where I grew up.
accepted: This is the town where I grew up.

items.prompt: Technology keeps advancing. Many traditional jobs are disappearing. (concession)
items.answer: Even though technology keeps advancing, many traditional jobs are disappearing.
accepted: Even though technology keeps advancing, many traditional jobs are disappearing.

items.prompt: Some countries recycle most of their waste. Others send it to landfill. (contrast)
items.answer: While some countries recycle most of their waste, others send it to landfill.
accepted: While some countries recycle most of their waste, others send it to landfill.

blocks: Defining আর non-defining relative clause দেখতে প্রায় একই রকম -- পার্থক্য শুধু এক জোড়া comma, কিন্তু এই punctuation-ই sentence-এর অর্থ পুরোপুরি বদলে দেয়।
**কেন গুরুত্বপূর্ণ:** Relative clause-এর এই অংশটাই আসলে নম্বর আনে -- comma-গুলো সাজসজ্জা নয়, এগুলো sentence-এর অর্থ বদলে দেয়।
**Defining clause** বলে দেয় ঠিক কোনটা, তাই এটা অপরিহার্য -- কোনো comma নেই: Students who cheat are expelled (শুধু যারা cheat করে তারা)।
**Non-defining clause** বাড়তি, অপ্রয়োজনীয় তথ্য যোগ করে, দুই পাশে comma দিয়ে ঘেরা: The students, who were tired, left early (সবাই)।
**that** শুধু defining clause-এ ব্যবহার করুন। Non-defining clause-এ **which** বা **who** ব্যবহার করুন -- কখনোই that নয়।
Relative clause-এর পরে pronoun দিয়ে subject আবার বসাবেন না (বাংলার প্রভাবে এটা খুবই সাধারণ একটা ভুল)।
Reduced relative clause sentence-কে আরও আঁটসাঁট করে: governments that invest in renewables → governments investing in renewables।

blocks.title: Exercise 5.2 · Punctuation ও Relative Clause ঘষামাজা
blocks.instructions: প্রতিটি sentence-এ হয় comma নেই, নয়তো relative pronoun নেই, অথবা একটা punctuation-এর ভুল আছে। প্রতিটি সঠিকভাবে আবার লিখুন।

items.prompt: The city which is famous for its food attracts many tourists.
items.answer: The city that is famous for its food attracts many tourists.
accepted: The city that is famous for its food attracts many tourists.
The city which is famous for its food attracts many tourists.
items.reason: Defining clause: comma লাগবে না। “which”-ও গ্রহণযোগ্য।

items.prompt: My brother who lives in Canada is an engineer. (I have only one brother.)
items.answer: My brother, who lives in Canada, is an engineer.
accepted: My brother, who lives in Canada, is an engineer.
items.reason: ভাই মাত্র একজন, তাই clause-টা non-defining: comma লাগবে।

items.prompt: Students who cheat in exams they are usually expelled.
items.answer: Students who cheat in exams are usually expelled.
accepted: Students who cheat in exams are usually expelled.

items.prompt: The report was clear, it recommended three changes.
items.answer: The report was clear; it recommended three changes.
accepted: The report was clear; it recommended three changes.
The report was clear. It recommended three changes.
items.reason: Semicolon বা full stop দিয়ে comma splice ঠিক করুন।

items.prompt: Although the policy was expensive. It reduced accidents significantly.
items.answer: Although the policy was expensive, it reduced accidents significantly.
accepted: Although the policy was expensive, it reduced accidents significantly.
items.reason: Comma দিয়ে fragment-টাকে main clause-এর সাথে জুড়ে দিন।

items.prompt: Solar power which is renewable is becoming cheaper.
items.answer: Solar power, which is renewable, is becoming cheaper.
accepted: Solar power, which is renewable, is becoming cheaper.

items.prompt: People which live near factories often suffer from poor air quality.
items.answer: People who live near factories often suffer from poor air quality.
accepted: People who live near factories often suffer from poor air quality.

items.prompt: Governments that invest in transport, tend to see lower long-term costs.
items.answer: Governments that invest in transport tend to see lower long-term costs.
accepted: Governments that invest in transport tend to see lower long-term costs.
items.reason: Defining clause: অপ্রয়োজনীয় comma-টা সরিয়ে দিন।

items.prompt: The scheme was popular, however it was cancelled after two years.
items.answer: The scheme was popular; however, it was cancelled after two years.
accepted: The scheme was popular; however, it was cancelled after two years.
items.reason: “however” শুধু একটা comma দিয়ে দুটো clause জুড়তে পারে না; semicolon ব্যবহার করুন।

items.prompt: The teacher whose class I attended last year has now retired.
items.answer: Correct.
accepted: Correct.
Correct
The teacher whose class I attended last year has now retired.
items.reason: মালিকানা বোঝাতে “whose”; sentence-টা আগে থেকেই ঠিক আছে।

items.prompt: Because the weather was extremely bad. The outdoor event was postponed.
items.answer: Because the weather was extremely bad, the outdoor event was postponed.
accepted: Because the weather was extremely bad, the outdoor event was postponed.

items.prompt: Dhaka which is the capital of Bangladesh is extremely crowded.
items.answer: Dhaka, which is the capital of Bangladesh, is extremely crowded.
accepted: Dhaka, which is the capital of Bangladesh, is extremely crowded.
